rounds.response:
I’m in the big blind (Player 0) with J♥ 5♣. The pot is 30 and the current single raise stands at 20 chips. I’ve already posted the big-blind portion of that bet (10), so it’s 10 more to me. 

J5o is an unconnected, offsuit hand with no real value either pre-flop or post-flop unless it catches a miracle two-pair or trips—basically the textbook “fold” hand from out of position. Throw in the facts that  
- I have the deeper stack so losing 10 more now is small relative to 990 chips,  
- but paying 10 more automatically seeds a half-pot when OOP vs. what could easily be a stronger range, and  
- in future hands I’ll have the positional advantage when the button shifts, 

…I see zero upside in peeling here. Folding keeps the loss to the mandatory 10-chip big blind and moves to the next hand.

[Fold]
